title: /harness/branch/[branch]/[...at]/shells/[entity]/details
responsibility: Shows the contract and measurements of one shell, and its source only when that is asked for.

inputs.name: branch
inputs.description: The branch, as one encoded path segment. Its tip is shown unless a commit is named.

inputs.name: commit
inputs.description: After /commit/: the selected commit, compared with its first parent. Absent, the tip is shown alone.

inputs.name: entity
inputs.description: The id of the shell, as one encoded path segment.

inputs.name: tab
inputs.description: Query: the tab shown in place of the contract. Source is shown under source alone.

outputs.name: +page
outputs.description: The contract of the shell; by tab its measurements, an unavailable one with its reason, and its source.

errors.name: not-in-history
errors.description: A branch or commit the history does not hold, or a commit the branch does not contain, is said. No other revision is shown.

errors.name: no-registry
errors.description: A revision that stores no unit registry says so. The registry of another revision is not shown.

errors.name: not-at-revision
errors.description: A shell the shown revision does not hold is said, with the way back to the collection.

errors.name: other-category
errors.description: A unit that is not a shell at this revision is led to the address of its own category.

errors.name: not-admitted
errors.description: A request the owner policy does not admit is refused before any history is read.
